result.markdown: --- title: "[Graph.to_undirected()]{.doc-object-name .doc-function .doc-label .doc-label-method}" body-classes: doc-api-page page-navigation: false html-table-processing: none --- ::: {.doc-subject} Convert the graph to an undirected graph. ::: ::: {.doc-usage-source} Usage [Source](https://github.com/rich-iannone/edgecase/blob/main/python/edgecase/graph.py#L11513-L11574){target="_blank" rel="noopener"} ::: ::: {.doc-signature .doc-Kind.FUNCTION} ```python Graph.to_undirected() ``` ::: ::: {.doc-text} Creates a new graph with the same nodes and edges, but without edge direction. If the graph is already undirected, returns a new copy. For directed graphs, converts directed edges to undirected edges, removing duplicate pairs. ::: ## Returns {.doc-returns} ::: {.doc-definition-items} [Graph]{.doc-parameter-annotation} : A new undirected Graph with the same nodes and edges. ::: ## Examples {.doc-examples} Convert a directed graph to undirected: ::: {#fa63bb26 .cell execution_count=1} ``` {.python .cell-code} import edgecase as ec directed = ( ec.Graph(directed=True) .add_node(label="A") .add_node(label="B") .add_node(label="C") .add_edge("A", "B") .add_edge("B", "C") .add_edge("C", "A") ) undirected = directed.to_undirected() # Returns False undirected.is_directed() ``` ::: {.cell-output .cell-output-display execution_count=1} ``` False ``` ::: ::: ::: {#4fe52851 .cell execution_count=2} ``` {.python .cell-code} # Returns 3 (one per unique pair) undirected.count_edges() ``` ::: {.cell-output .cell-output-display execution_count=2} ``` 3 ``` ::: ::: Use case for symmetrizing a social network: ::: {#fa6fb4eb .cell execution_count=3} ``` {.python .cell-code} # Directed: A follows B, B follows C followers = ( ec.Graph(directed=True) .add_node(label="Alice") .add_node(label="Bob") .add_node(label="Charlie") .add_edge("Alice", "Bob") .add_edge("Bob", "Charlie") ) # Undirected: mutual connections connections = followers.to_undirected() ``` :::
